lightings.name: Three-point lighting
lightings.name_th: ไฟสามจุด
lightings.setup: Key 30-45° off camera axis, slightly above eye level; fill on the opposite side near the lens axis, 1-2 stops under the key; back/rim light behind the subject opposite the camera, aimed at hair/shoulders.
lightings.source_size: medium (softbox 60-90 cm) for key; larger/bounced fill; small hard rim
lightings.intensity_ratio: key:fill 2:1 to 4:1; rim about equal to key on the edge
lightings.color_temperature_note: Usually one matched temperature; a cooler rim is a common creative variation.
lightings.shadow_quality: moderate, defined nose/cheek shadow with readable detail
lightings.material_response: Skin modelled with soft highlight; hair gets an edge line; metal frames show one key highlight and a rim streak; matte fabric reads evenly.
lightings.depth_and_form: Key gives form, fill controls contrast, rim separates figure from background (figure-ground).
avoid_for: natural documentary look where three sources feel staged
common_mistakes: fill as bright as key (flat)
rim so hot it clips hair
key at eye level reflecting in glasses
unmotivated rim in a scene with no back source
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness. Inverse square: for a compact source, doubling the distance quarters the illuminance (-2 stops); a close source falls off fast across the scene (dark background), a far one lights everything evenly.
prompt_phrases: classic three-point lighting: soft key from camera left at 45 degrees slightly above eye level, gentle fill, thin rim light on hair and shoulders
shadow side about one stop darker, subject clearly separated from a dark background
lightings.eyewear_notes: Glasses: keep the key above eye level and/or well off the lens axis so its mirror image bounces out of the lens toward floor or side; a slight chin-down or head turn away from the key moves it further; ask for 'clear anti-reflective lenses, eyes fully visible, no glare'. Do not remove every reflection: a faint edge highlight proves a lens is there (house 'lens layer' rule). The rim may draw a thin bright line along the top of the frame: keep it, it outlines the frame shape.

lightings.name: Soft key + fill
lightings.name_th: ไฟหลักนุ่มกับไฟเสริม
lightings.setup: One large soft key (softbox 90-150 cm or diffused window) close at 30-45°, fill from a white bounce card or second soft source on the other side; no rim.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Daylight-balanced commercial default; go 3200-4000 K for warmth.
lightings.shadow_quality: soft, long gradient, gentle nose shadow
lightings.material_response: Forgiving on skin texture; glossy frames show large soft highlights; fabric texture subdued.
lightings.depth_and_form: Gentle modelling; depth comes mostly from tone separation and lens blur rather than light.
best_for: lens and eyewear ads with people
common_mistakes: source too far (loses softness)
no shadow side at all, face looks pasted
huge softbox reflected as a white square on lenses
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: large soft key light from the left, white bounce fill on the right, gentle low-contrast shadows
soft even commercial portrait light, shadow side only slightly darker
lightings.eyewear_notes: Large close sources make a big but faint reflection; raise the box above the head and feather it so the lens shows a soft edge gradient, not a white panel. Glasses: keep the key above eye level and/or well off the lens axis so its mirror image bounces out of the lens toward floor or side; a slight chin-down or head turn away from the key moves it further; ask for 'clear anti-reflective lenses, eyes fully visible, no glare'. Do not remove every reflection: a faint edge highlight proves a lens is there (house 'lens layer' rule).

lightings.name: Broad lighting
lightings.name_th: ไฟส่องฝั่งหน้ากว้าง
lightings.setup: Face turned partly away from the key; the key lights the side of the face closest to camera (the broad side). Pattern (loop/Rembrandt) can be combined.
lightings.key_direction: key on the same side the face is turned away from; ~45° from camera
lightings.color_temperature_note: Any; set by the scene.
lightings.shadow_quality: small shadow area on the far cheek
lightings.material_response: More lit skin area facing camera; frames' near temple arm catches the highlight.
lightings.depth_and_form: Widens and flattens the face; less sculpting than short lighting.
common_mistakes: calling it a pattern instead of a side choice
lighting the broad side then adding equal fill (flat)
lightings.physics_notes: Which side is 'broad' depends on head turn relative to camera, not on light position alone. Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: broad lighting, the side of the face turned toward the camera is lit
face turned slightly away from a soft key light, near cheek brightly lit
lightings.eyewear_notes: Recommended for glasses: with the head turned away from the key, the key's reflection leaves the lens on the far side. Glasses: keep the key above eye level and/or well off the lens axis so its mirror image bounces out of the lens toward floor or side; a slight chin-down or head turn away from the key moves it further; ask for 'clear anti-reflective lenses, eyes fully visible, no glare'. Do not remove every reflection: a faint edge highlight proves a lens is there (house 'lens layer' rule).

lightings.name: Short lighting
lightings.name_th: ไฟส่องฝั่งหน้าแคบ
lightings.setup: Face turned partly toward the key; the key lights the side turned away from camera (short side), the near cheek falls into shadow.
lightings.key_direction: key on the side the face turns toward, ~45-60° from camera
lightings.color_temperature_note: Any.
lightings.material_response: Skin texture shown on the far side; near frame arm sits in shadow.
lightings.depth_and_form: Slims and sculpts the face, strong 3D modelling.
avoid_for: glasses wearers facing the key directly (glare)
common_mistakes: turning the face into the key so the lenses mirror it
losing the near eye in darkness
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: short lighting, the far side of the face lit, the side nearer the camera in soft shadow
sculpted face, key light on the side turned away from the lens
lightings.eyewear_notes: Face turned toward the key is the riskiest angle for lens glare; raise the key higher or move it further round so the reflection exits above/aside. Glasses: keep the key above eye level and/or well off the lens axis so its mirror image bounces out of the lens toward floor or side; a slight chin-down or head turn away from the key moves it further; ask for 'clear anti-reflective lenses, eyes fully visible, no glare'. Do not remove every reflection: a faint edge highlight proves a lens is there (house 'lens layer' rule).

lightings.name: Butterfly / Paramount
lightings.name_th: ไฟผีเสื้อ
lightings.setup: Key directly in front on the camera axis, high above the face (30-50° up), pointing down; small butterfly-shaped shadow under the nose.
lightings.intensity_ratio: key:fill 2:1 to 4:1 (fill often a reflector below)
lightings.color_temperature_note: Daylight beauty; tungsten for vintage Hollywood.
lightings.shadow_quality: symmetrical, nose and under-cheekbone shadows, crisp with a dish
lightings.material_response: Cheekbones and lips glossed; frames cast a shadow line on the cheeks below the rims.
lightings.depth_and_form: Emphasises cheekbones and symmetry; flattens the sides.
common_mistakes: too high: eye sockets black
frame shadow cutting across the eyes
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: butterfly lighting, key light high and directly in front, small butterfly shadow under the nose
glamorous Paramount-style portrait light
lightings.eyewear_notes: High frontal key reflects down and away from the lens if high enough, but the frame's top bar casts a shadow on the eyes; tilt chin slightly up or add under-fill. Check reflections of the dish as a round catch on the lens.

lightings.name: Loop lighting
lightings.name_th: ไฟลูป
lightings.setup: Key 30-45° to one side and a little above eye level; the nose shadow forms a small loop pointing down toward the mouth corner without touching the cheek shadow.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Any.
lightings.material_response: Natural skin modelling, one clear catchlight per eye; frames get a side highlight.
lightings.depth_and_form: Flattering moderate modelling for most faces.
common_mistakes: key too low, loop merges into flat light
fill killing the loop
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness. Exact loop position depends on face structure (curriculum-04).
prompt_phrases: loop lighting, soft key from 40 degrees left slightly above eye level, small nose shadow angled down
natural flattering portrait light
lightings.eyewear_notes: Raise the key a bit more than usual (the loop still holds) so its reflection drops out of the lens. Glasses: keep the key above eye level and/or well off the lens axis so its mirror image bounces out of the lens toward floor or side; a slight chin-down or head turn away from the key moves it further; ask for 'clear anti-reflective lenses, eyes fully visible, no glare'. Do not remove every reflection: a faint edge highlight proves a lens is there (house 'lens layer' rule).

lightings.name: Rembrandt lighting
lightings.name_th: ไฟเรมบรันต์
lightings.setup: Key ~45° side and higher than for loop; nose shadow meets the cheek shadow leaving a small lit triangle under the shadow-side eye. Little or no fill.
lightings.source_size: medium (window, softbox) or hard for grit
lightings.color_temperature_note: Often warm for a painterly feel.
lightings.shadow_quality: defined, triangle of light on the shadow cheek
lightings.material_response: Skin texture visible; metal frames show one strong highlight; dark fabrics fall into shadow.
lightings.depth_and_form: Strong sculpting, painterly chiaroscuro.
common_mistakes: triangle too big (becomes loop) or missing (becomes split)
shadow eye with no catchlight looks dead
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: Rembrandt lighting, key high at camera left, small triangle of light under the right eye, shadow side about two stops darker
painterly side light with deep but readable shadows
lightings.eyewear_notes: The lit triangle sits under the frame; make sure the rim does not cut through it. High key keeps the reflection out of the lens. Glasses: keep the key above eye level and/or well off the lens axis so its mirror image bounces out of the lens toward floor or side; a slight chin-down or head turn away from the key moves it further; ask for 'clear anti-reflective lenses, eyes fully visible, no glare'. Do not remove every reflection: a faint edge highlight proves a lens is there (house 'lens layer' rule).

lightings.name: Split lighting
lightings.name_th: ไฟแบ่งครึ่งหน้า
lightings.setup: Key at 90° to the side, about eye level; one half of the face lit, the other in shadow; no fill or negative fill.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Any; cool for menace, warm for introspection.
lightings.shadow_quality: hard dividing line down the nose
lightings.material_response: Skin texture strongly raked; metal and lens edge on the lit side flare.
lightings.depth_and_form: Strong form on one side, mystery on the other.
common_mistakes: shadow side fully black with nothing readable
using it on a sales portrait
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness. Raking light at 90° exaggerates surface relief.
prompt_phrases: split lighting, hard light from 90 degrees camera right, half the face in shadow
half-lit face, the other half fading into darkness
lightings.eyewear_notes: Side key at eye level grazes the near lens: Fresnel reflectance is high there, so expect a bright edge on the lit lens and none on the shadow lens. Keep it as an edge highlight; avoid a full lens flare. Fresnel: reflectance of glass, skin oil and lacquer rises steeply toward grazing angles, so tilted lens surfaces and rims mirror bright surroundings strongly.

lightings.name: Clamshell
lightings.name_th: ไฟฝาหอย
lightings.setup: Butterfly key high in front plus a reflector or second soft light below the chin facing up; camera shoots between them.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Daylight beauty standard.
lightings.material_response: Skin smooth and luminous; double catchlights; glossy frames shine top and bottom.
lightings.depth_and_form: Low modelling; flat-glamorous.
common_mistakes: bottom fill stronger than top (horror under-light)
both sources mirrored as white bars in lenses
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: soft clamshell lighting, beauty dish above and white reflector below the chin, almost shadowless face, double catchlights
high-key beauty light
lightings.eyewear_notes: Two frontal sources = two chances of lens reflection; keep both large and slightly off-axis vertically, chin level, and request crystal-clear anti-reflective lenses. Used in curriculum-04 high-key lens ad example.

lightings.name: Rim light only
lightings.name_th: ไฟขอบอย่างเดียว
lightings.setup: One or two lights behind the subject, opposite the camera, just out of frame; no front light; edges glow, front stays dark.
lightings.source_size: small/hard (sharp line) or strip box (wider soft edge)
lightings.intensity_ratio: front almost unlit; rim 2-3 stops over the front
lightings.color_temperature_note: Cool rims read as night/moon; warm as sunset.
lightings.shadow_quality: front mostly in shadow, bright edge outline
lightings.material_response: Hair and fabric fuzz glow; glass and acetate edges light up; skin shows a thin line.
lightings.depth_and_form: Pure outline; strong figure-ground but little interior form.
common_mistakes: light visible in frame causing flare
rim on one side only reading as a mistake
lightings.physics_notes: Fresnel: reflectance of glass, skin oil and lacquer rises steeply toward grazing angles, so tilted lens surfaces and rims mirror bright surroundings strongly. Edge glow is strongest where surfaces are seen at grazing angle.
prompt_phrases: rim light only, subject outlined by a thin bright edge against a black background
backlit edges glowing, face mostly in shadow
lightings.eyewear_notes: Excellent for frames: lens edges and acetate rims glow and the frame outline reads on black. Lenses themselves stay dark; add a faint front fill or a single strip reflection so lenses do not look empty.

lightings.name: Backlit silhouette
lightings.name_th: ย้อนแสงเป็นเงาดำ
lightings.setup: Bright background (sky, window, lit wall) exposed correctly; subject unlit in front, rendered as a dark shape. No fill.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Set by the background: sunset warm, blue hour cool.
lightings.material_response: Only outline and transparent parts (lenses, hair) carry light.
lightings.depth_and_form: Form reduced to contour; shape must read on its own.
common_mistakes: overlapping limbs make an unreadable blob
lifting shadows so it becomes a muddy grey figure
lightings.physics_notes: Camera dynamic range forces a choice: exposing for the bright background drops the subject to near black.
prompt_phrases: strong backlit silhouette against a glowing sky, no fill light, the figure a clean dark shape
profile silhouette with clear readable outline
lightings.eyewear_notes: In profile, the frame and lens shape become part of the silhouette — a strong way to show a frame's outline. Light passing through the lens can glow slightly; keep it subtle.

lightings.name: High key
lightings.name_th: โทนสว่าง
lightings.setup: Low ratio key/fill, background lit separately 1-2 stops brighter than the subject, often to pure white; minimal shadows.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Neutral daylight.
lightings.material_response: Whites glow; clear lenses and transparent acetate can disappear into white unless edged.
lightings.depth_and_form: Low modelling; shape read from outline and colour.
common_mistakes: background spill wrapping edges (loss of contrast)
clear frames vanishing
clipping skin
lightings.physics_notes: Background flare scatters back into the lens and lowers contrast; flag the backlights.
prompt_phrases: high-key image, pure white background, soft shadowless light, bright and clean
very low contrast, airy bright studio
lightings.eyewear_notes: Clear/crystal frames need black cards beside them or a slightly grey background so edges stay visible; give each lens a soft grey edge reflection.

lightings.name: Low key
lightings.name_th: โทนมืด
lightings.setup: One hard or medium key, high ratio, negative fill on the shadow side, dark background; optional rim for separation.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Warm practical key or cool moon key.
lightings.material_response: Specular highlights on metal and lenses pop; skin texture raked; dark fabric disappears.
lightings.depth_and_form: Strong form where lit; depth from pools of light.
best_for: ร้านแว่นตีสอง night scenes
avoid_for: small phone thumbnails where dark detail is lost
common_mistakes: no rim: dark hair merges with dark background
lifting exposure globally instead of adding motivated highlights
lightings.physics_notes: Inverse square: for a compact source, doubling the distance quarters the illuminance (-2 stops); a close source falls off fast across the scene (dark background), a far one lights everything evenly. Close key + distance to background = fast falloff.
prompt_phrases: low-key lighting, single hard key light, deep shadows, dark background, thin rim light separating the subject
most of the frame in deep shadow, only the face and the glasses lit
lightings.eyewear_notes: Specular lens/rim highlights are the brightest points in a low-key frame and pull the eye: place them deliberately. Keep eyes visible behind lenses with a tiny eye-light.

lightings.name: Chiaroscuro
lightings.name_th: แสงเงาตัดกัน (ภาพวาด)
lightings.setup: Single directional source modelling forms with a full value range: light, halftone, core shadow, reflected light, cast shadow; background mid-dark.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Painterly warm light, cool shadows (Artistic convention).
lightings.shadow_quality: gradual turning from light to shadow with a clear core shadow
lightings.material_response: Fabrics show folds; skin a rich halftone; metal sparkle small.
lightings.depth_and_form: Maximum volume: form described by the light-to-shadow sequence (Gurney2010).
common_mistakes: skipping halftones so it looks like split light
black shadows with no reflected light
lightings.physics_notes: Shading follows Lambert's cosine: brightness falls as the surface turns away from the light; reflected light from nearby surfaces lifts the shadow edge.
prompt_phrases: chiaroscuro lighting, single window light from upper left, rich gradation from light to deep shadow
painterly volume, strong modelling, warm light and cool shadows
lightings.eyewear_notes: Paint/ask for one small bright highlight on the frame front and a dim reflection in the lens; keep the eye legible inside the shadow.

lightings.name: Tenebrism
lightings.name_th: แสงตัดมืดจัด
lightings.setup: Extreme version of chiaroscuro: a narrow, hard beam lights only the subject; most of the frame falls to near-black.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Warm candle/lamp feel is typical.
lightings.material_response: Lit skin glows against void; metal flashes; dark materials vanish.
lightings.depth_and_form: Selected forms leap from darkness; background depth disappears.
common_mistakes: too many lit areas
losing the silhouette in black
lightings.physics_notes: Inverse square: for a compact source, doubling the distance quarters the illuminance (-2 stops); a close source falls off fast across the scene (dark background), a far one lights everything evenly. A focused source plus dark surroundings gives almost no ambient bounce.
prompt_phrases: tenebrism, a single narrow beam of warm light, everything else in near-total darkness
dramatic baroque-style light on one figure
lightings.eyewear_notes: The beam's reflection in the lens can become a hot spot; aim the beam high so lenses show only a thin edge highlight.

lightings.name: Golden hour
lightings.name_th: แสงช่วงทอง
lightings.setup: Sun low (roughly 0-10° elevation), side- or backlight; open sky acts as cool fill; long shadows.
lightings.source_size: small/hard sun softened by atmosphere; large sky fill
lightings.color_temperature_note: Direct low sun; the sky fill is much cooler.
lightings.material_response: Skin warm and glowing; metal frames flare gold; lenses can flare toward camera when backlit.
lightings.depth_and_form: Raking light reveals texture; backlight separates subject; haze adds aerial depth.
common_mistakes: shooting straight into sun without exposing for face
orange everything with no cool contrast
lightings.physics_notes: Rayleigh scattering removes blue from the long low-sun path (warm direct light) while the sky that remains acts as a blue fill. Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: golden hour, low warm sun from behind and to the left, long soft shadows, glowing rim on hair
warm sunlight with cool blue shadows, gentle haze
lightings.eyewear_notes: Backlit sun hits the lens surfaces at grazing angles (Fresnel) and may flare across the eyes; turn the face so the sun is behind-side, and ask for 'no lens flare over the eyes'. Sunglasses: a small warm highlight on the lens is attractive.

lightings.name: Blue hour
lightings.name_th: แสงช่วงฟ้าคราม
lightings.setup: Sun just below the horizon; whole sky is a large soft blue source; warm practicals (windows, streetlights) start to read.
lightings.key_direction: diffuse from the sky, brighter toward the sunset side
lightings.intensity_ratio: low contrast ambient; practicals pop 1-3 stops over
lightings.color_temperature_note: Approximate sky appearance; practicals 2700-3500 K.
lightings.shadow_quality: almost none from sky; small hard ones from practicals
lightings.material_response: Skin cool; glossy surfaces mirror the blue sky; lenses show cool sky reflection.
lightings.depth_and_form: Low form from sky; depth from warm practical pools against blue.
common_mistakes: waiting too long (black sky)
white-balancing the blue away
lightings.physics_notes: After sunset the remaining scattered skylight is dominated by short wavelengths; there is no direct sun, so the source is the whole sky.
prompt_phrases: blue hour dusk, deep blue sky, warm glowing shop windows
cool ambient twilight with small warm practical lights
lightings.eyewear_notes: Lenses mirror the blue sky; a warm shop-light catch on the frame adds a nice warm/cool accent. Keep the eye visible with a soft warm face light from a motivated window.

lightings.name: Overcast soft
lightings.name_th: แสงฟ้าครึ้ม
lightings.setup: Cloud layer diffuses the sun into a huge overhead softbox; use a roof edge or dark side (negative fill) to add direction.
lightings.key_direction: top, slightly toward the brighter sky
lightings.color_temperature_note: Cool; warm up slightly for skin.
lightings.shadow_quality: very soft, under-eye and under-chin shadows
lightings.material_response: True colours, no glare; metal looks dull; matte fabric excellent.
lightings.depth_and_form: Low modelling; can look flat without negative fill.
common_mistakes: flat faces without negative fill
racoon eyes from pure top light
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: soft overcast daylight, diffused even light, gentle shadows
cloudy-day light with true colours
lightings.eyewear_notes: Large uniform sky gives soft reflections over the whole lens; request 'clear lenses, minimal reflection' and show a darker area (trees, wall) mirrored in the lens so the eyes read.

lightings.name: Midday hard sun
lightings.name_th: แดดเที่ยงจัด
lightings.setup: High sun (50-90° elevation), direct, with blue sky fill; optional scrim or bounce to control faces.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Direct daylight around 5500 K.
lightings.material_response: Intense speculars on metal, water, lenses; skin shine; saturated colours.
lightings.depth_and_form: Top-down shadows hide eyes, emphasise top surfaces.
common_mistakes: eye sockets black
clipped speculars
lightings.physics_notes: The sun subtends about 0.5°, so even though it is huge it is effectively a small source: sharp shadows. Angle of incidence = angle of reflection: a highlight on glass, varnish or metal is a mirror image of the source; move the source or tilt the surface to move it.
prompt_phrases: harsh midday sun, short hard shadows, intense bright light
hard graphic shadows on the ground, vivid saturated colours
lightings.eyewear_notes: Good context for UV/sunglass content (pterygium, glare). For readable eyes, shade the face or use sunglasses as the subject; frames cast crisp shadow shapes that can be a graphic element.

lightings.name: Window side light
lightings.name_th: แสงหน้าต่างด้านข้าง
lightings.setup: Subject 0.5-2 m from a window, 45-90° to it; window acts as a large soft key; room or a white card fills the far side.
lightings.intensity_ratio: 2:1 to 8:1 depending on distance to far wall
lightings.color_temperature_note: Skylight; direct sun warmer.
lightings.shadow_quality: soft, quick falloff across the face
lightings.material_response: Skin natural; frames get a long window-shaped highlight; lenses mirror the window shape.
lightings.depth_and_form: Beautiful form via falloff; background darkens with distance from window.
common_mistakes: subject too far from window (dim, flat)
window blown out in frame with no control
lightings.physics_notes: Inverse square: for a compact source, doubling the distance quarters the illuminance (-2 stops); a close source falls off fast across the scene (dark background), a far one lights everything evenly. Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: soft window light from the left, gentle falloff into shadow on the right side of the face
natural side light from a large window, quiet interior
lightings.eyewear_notes: Lens shows a rectangular window reflection when the face turns toward it; turn the face 20-30° away or raise the subject so the reflection leaves the lens. A small window catch on the frame edge is welcome.

lightings.name: North window (studio skylight)
lightings.name_th: หน้าต่างทิศเหนือ
lightings.setup: Large window receiving only skylight, never direct sun (north-facing in the northern hemisphere), often high; constant cool soft light for painters.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Cool skylight; colour stays consistent through the day.
lightings.shadow_quality: soft but directional, cool light / warmer shadows in painting convention
lightings.material_response: Accurate colour, gentle sheen on metal; matte surfaces modelled softly.
lightings.depth_and_form: Classic atelier modelling, reliable form shadows.
common_mistakes: mixing with warm room light unintentionally
lightings.physics_notes: No direct sun means the source is the sky patch seen through the opening: stable intensity and colour. In Thailand (low latitude) a north window still mostly avoids direct sun.
prompt_phrases: cool north window light from high on the left, soft directional studio light
artist studio skylight, calm even modelling
lightings.eyewear_notes: High window keeps reflections in the upper lens; tilt the frames slightly down in product still lifes.

lightings.name: Practical lamp
lightings.name_th: โคมไฟในฉาก
lightings.setup: A visible lamp in frame motivates the key; a hidden film light matching its direction, colour and hardness does the real work; ambient kept low.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Tungsten/warm LED.
lightings.material_response: Skin golden; metal frames warm-gold glints; lenses mirror the lamp as a small bright shape.
lightings.depth_and_form: Pools of light create depth zones.
best_for: ร้านแว่นตีสอง
common_mistakes: face lit from a direction with no lamp
lamp blown out with no detail
lightings.physics_notes: Inverse square: for a compact source, doubling the distance quarters the illuminance (-2 stops); a close source falls off fast across the scene (dark background), a far one lights everything evenly. Motivated light must match source direction, colour and hardness (curriculum-04).
prompt_phrases: lit only by a warm table lamp beside her, soft pool of 2700K light, the rest of the room in shadow
motivated practical lighting from a desk lamp
lightings.eyewear_notes: Lamp in frame will appear in lenses facing it; place it beside rather than in front, or let a tiny lamp reflection sit at the lens edge. Glasses: keep the key above eye level and/or well off the lens axis so its mirror image bounces out of the lens toward floor or side; a slight chin-down or head turn away from the key moves it further; ask for 'clear anti-reflective lenses, eyes fully visible, no glare'. Do not remove every reflection: a faint edge highlight proves a lens is there (house 'lens layer' rule).

lightings.name: Candle / firelight
lightings.name_th: แสงเทียน/ไฟกองไฟ
lightings.setup: Low warm flicker source close to the face, usually below or at chin height; deep surrounding dark.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Flame around 1800-2000 K.
lightings.material_response: Skin deep orange; metal warm glints; lenses glow orange.
lightings.depth_and_form: Strong falloff; only near surfaces lit.
common_mistakes: flame bright but face unrealistically even
no flicker in video
lightings.physics_notes: Inverse square: for a compact source, doubling the distance quarters the illuminance (-2 stops); a close source falls off fast across the scene (dark background), a far one lights everything evenly. Strong falloff because the source is so close.
prompt_phrases: lit only by candlelight, warm flickering 1800K glow on the face, deep darkness around
firelight dancing on faces
lightings.eyewear_notes: Candle in front makes twin flame reflections in the lenses: cute in a story frame, distracting in a product frame. Move the flame off-axis.

lightings.name: Neon night
lightings.name_th: ไฟนีออนกลางคืน
lightings.setup: Coloured signs (magenta, cyan, red) as motivated keys and rims; wet ground reflects; low ambient.
lightings.source_size: linear tubes = medium/soft in one axis
lightings.color_temperature_note: Saturated non-white colours, not on the Kelvin scale; mix with a 3000 K warm practical for skin.
lightings.material_response: Skin takes colour casts; glossy frames carry coloured streaks; lenses mirror signs.
lightings.depth_and_form: Colour separates planes (teal BG, magenta key).
common_mistakes: too many colours, green-purple skin patches
dry ground with no reflections
lightings.physics_notes: Angle of incidence = angle of reflection: a highlight on glass, varnish or metal is a mirror image of the source; move the source or tilt the surface to move it. Wet surfaces turn diffuse into specular, doubling the light sources in frame.
prompt_phrases: neon night, magenta and cyan sign light on her face, wet asphalt reflections
rainy street lit by red neon, deep shadows
lightings.eyewear_notes: Neon streaks on lenses look stylish; keep them on the lens edge and the eyes clear. Real frame colour will shift — state 'true frame colour kept' or do a separate product shot.

lightings.name: Sodium streetlight
lightings.name_th: ไฟถนนโซเดียม
lightings.setup: High overhead orange-yellow streetlights in pools along a street; little fill between pools.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Low-pressure sodium is near-monochromatic (~589 nm) so a Kelvin value is only an approximation; high-pressure sodium ~2000-2200 K.
lightings.material_response: Colours collapse toward orange/brown (monochromatic light kills colour discrimination); metal yellow.
lightings.depth_and_form: Pools mark depth along the street.
common_mistakes: mixing with white LED unintentionally
faces with black eye sockets
lightings.physics_notes: Near-monochromatic light means surfaces differ only in lightness, not hue.
prompt_phrases: orange sodium streetlight from above, pools of light on an empty street
late-night sodium-vapour glow, gritty
lightings.eyewear_notes: Top light shadows the eyes under the frame bar; tilt face up toward the lamp or add a faint cool fill. Lenses mirror lamp pools as orange dots.

lightings.name: Moonlight (blue)
lightings.name_th: แสงจันทร์สีน้ำเงิน
lightings.setup: Cinematic convention: a cool, often high backlight or side light suggests the moon; warm practicals inside; underexposed overall but readable.
lightings.source_size: hard (single moon) or soft (large lit sky)
lightings.color_temperature_note: Real moonlight is reflected sunlight (slightly warmer); the blue look is a film/perception convention (low-light vision shifts toward blue).
lightings.material_response: Skin cool, desaturated; metal silver; lenses mirror cool highlights.
lightings.depth_and_form: Rims and edges carry form.
best_for: ร้านแว่นตีสอง
common_mistakes: blue everywhere with no warm accent
too dark to read on phone
lightings.physics_notes: Under dim (mesopic) conditions human vision shifts sensitivity toward shorter wavelengths (Purkinje shift), one reason blue reads as night.
prompt_phrases: cool blue moonlight backlighting the scene, warm window glow inside
night lit by pale blue moonlight, silver rim light on shoulders
lightings.eyewear_notes: Cool rim along the frame top outlines it nicely; keep a warm eye-light so the eyes behind the lens stay alive.

lightings.name: Volumetric god rays
lightings.name_th: ลำแสงทะลุหมอก
lightings.setup: Hard source (sun, spot) through gaps (window, trees, blinds) into haze/dust/smoke; camera looks across or toward the beams.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Warm sun shafts or cool spot.
lightings.material_response: Dust glitters; skin edge-lit; lenses may flare when beams enter them.
lightings.depth_and_form: Beams describe 3D space and distance.
common_mistakes: rays from several directions
fog so dense the subject is lost
lightings.physics_notes: Visible beams need scattering particles (Mie scattering from dust/droplets); scattering is strongest looking toward the source (forward scattering).
prompt_phrases: volumetric god rays through a window into dusty air
sunbeams cutting through haze, visible light shafts
lightings.eyewear_notes: Beams that hit the lens can create flare; place the subject beside the beam, with a shaft crossing the background.

lightings.name: Fog / atmospheric haze
lightings.name_th: หมอกและบรรยากาศ
lightings.setup: Haze or fog reduces contrast with distance; backlight increases glow; subject close to camera stays clear.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Takes the colour of the light sources.
lightings.material_response: Distant objects lose saturation; near metal still glints.
lightings.depth_and_form: Aerial perspective: distance = lighter, lower contrast, bluer (curriculum-03).
common_mistakes: fog equal everywhere (no depth)
subject also fogged
lightings.physics_notes: Scattering adds veiling light and reduces contrast in proportion to distance (aerial perspective).
prompt_phrases: morning fog, layers fading into soft grey distance
atmospheric haze, distant mountains pale and blue
lightings.eyewear_notes: Keep the eyewear in the near, clear layer; fog behind makes frame edges read.

lightings.name: Underwater caustics
lightings.name_th: ลายแสงใต้น้ำ
lightings.setup: Sunlight refracted by a moving water surface forms bright dancing lines on surfaces below; blue-green colour, light from above.
lightings.intensity_ratio: high local contrast in caustic lines
lightings.color_temperature_note: Water absorbs red first, leaving blue-cyan; not a single Kelvin value.
lightings.material_response: Skin patterned; metal shimmer; glass refracts further.
lightings.depth_and_form: Pattern drapes over form, revealing contours.
common_mistakes: caustics on surfaces above water
static pattern in video
lightings.physics_notes: Refraction at a curved surface focuses light into caustic curves; water absorbs long wavelengths with depth.
prompt_phrases: sunlight caustics rippling across the sandy pool floor
shimmering water light patterns on skin
lightings.eyewear_notes: Rippling light over sunglasses on a poolside table is a good summer product idea; caustic patterns on the frame read as motion.

lightings.name: Dappled foliage light
lightings.name_th: แสงลอดใบไม้
lightings.setup: Sun through leaves; gaps act as pinhole cameras projecting round/elliptical sun spots; shade elsewhere.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Shade is green-tinted by leaf bounce.
lightings.material_response: Skin speckled; frames sparkle where hit.
lightings.depth_and_form: Breaks form into patches; can confuse faces.
common_mistakes: bright spot on a cheek or on the lens
green colour cast on skin
lightings.physics_notes: Small leaf gaps act as pinholes, so spots are images of the sun disc (ellipses on angled ground).
prompt_phrases: dappled sunlight through leaves, round sun spots on the ground
soft shade with flecks of sunlight
lightings.eyewear_notes: Avoid a sun spot on the lens; place the face in open shade with dapples on background or shoulders.

lightings.name: Theatrical spotlight
lightings.name_th: สปอตไลต์เวที
lightings.setup: Hard spot with a crisp circular pool on a dark stage, from above-front; nothing else lit.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Tungsten or daylight spot.
lightings.shadow_quality: hard, cast shadow inside the pool
lightings.material_response: Subject glows; metal glints.
lightings.depth_and_form: Pool isolates subject; ground circle anchors it.
common_mistakes: pool edge cutting the subject
spill lighting the background
lightings.physics_notes: A focusing optic (ellipsoidal/fresnel lens) narrows the beam: pool edge sharpness depends on focus.
prompt_phrases: single theatrical spotlight from above, crisp circle of light on a dark stage
one product under a hard spotlight, darkness around
lightings.eyewear_notes: Frames on a pedestal under a spot: aim slightly behind to rim the frame and avoid a hot spot in the lens.

lightings.name: Top light
lightings.name_th: แสงจากด้านบน
lightings.setup: Source directly above the subject; little fill; eyes fall into shadow.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Any.
lightings.material_response: Tops of hair, shoulders, frame top bar lit; lenses in shadow.
lightings.depth_and_form: Strong vertical modelling; hides eyes.
common_mistakes: eyes completely lost when a story needs them
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: hard top light, eyes in shadow under the brow
single overhead lamp, dark surroundings
lightings.eyewear_notes: Frame top bar shadows the eyes; with soft overhead light on a flatlay, reflections sit as one long soft panel across both lenses — usually attractive.

lightings.name: Under light (horror)
lightings.name_th: ไฟจากด้านล่าง (สยอง)
lightings.setup: Source below the face pointing up (flashlight, campfire); shadows go upward, against everyday experience of top light.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Flashlight white or warm fire.
lightings.shadow_quality: upward hard shadows over brows and nose
lightings.material_response: Under-surfaces lit; lenses catch light from below.
lightings.depth_and_form: Inverted form, unsettling.
common_mistakes: accidental under-light from a bright floor or a too-strong reflector
lightings.physics_notes: Perception tends to assume light from above (shape-from-shading 'light-from-above' prior); breaking it reads as wrong/unnatural.
prompt_phrases: flashlight under the chin lighting the face from below, spooky shadows going upward
eerie under-lighting
lightings.eyewear_notes: Light from below reflects up out of the lens toward the forehead, so lenses usually stay clear; the frame casts an upward shadow onto the brow.

lightings.name: Cross light
lightings.name_th: ไฟไขว้
lightings.setup: Two sources from opposite sides, each partly behind the subject (kicker/key pair), often for two people facing each other: each one's key is the other's rim.
lightings.intensity_ratio: each side ~1:1, centre of face darker
lightings.color_temperature_note: Often one warm and one cool.
lightings.shadow_quality: central shadow stripe down the face
lightings.material_response: Both edges lit; textures raked from two sides.
lightings.depth_and_form: Strong edge separation, dramatic volume.
common_mistakes: double nose shadows
both lights in frame flaring
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: cross lighting, two hard lights from opposite sides behind the subject, bright edges on both sides
warm light from the left and cool light from the right, centre of the face in shadow
lightings.eyewear_notes: Both temple arms and rim edges catch a line — a strong way to show frame thickness. Lenses often reflect one source: check each.

lightings.name: Warm bounce fill
lightings.name_th: เติมแสงสะท้อนโทนอุ่น
lightings.setup: Key as needed; fill comes from a gold/warm card or a warm-coloured wall bounce on the shadow side.
lightings.key_direction: key side any; fill opposite near camera
lightings.color_temperature_note: Fill warmer than the key by design.
lightings.material_response: Skin healthy glow; gold frames enriched.
lightings.depth_and_form: Shadows stay luminous, less contrast.
common_mistakes: gold card too strong (orange skin)
fill colour clashing with the key
lightings.physics_notes: A bounce surface becomes a large source tinted by its reflectance spectrum; nearby coloured walls do this unintentionally.
prompt_phrases: warm golden bounce light filling the shadows
soft warm fill from a gold reflector
lightings.eyewear_notes: Gold card below can reflect as a warm arc in the lower lens: keep it off-axis or low.

lightings.name: Ambient occlusion only
lightings.name_th: เงาจากการบังแสงรอบทิศ
lightings.setup: CG concept: shade each point by how much of the surrounding hemisphere is blocked by nearby geometry under uniform sky light; no direct light, no colour bleed.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Usually rendered grey/neutral; colour is not part of the concept.
lightings.shadow_quality: soft dark contact shadows in creases and where objects meet
lightings.material_response: All materials look like uniform clay; no reflections.
lightings.depth_and_form: Shows contact and crevices clearly; good for reading shape.
common_mistakes: over-dark AO halos
mistaking AO for full lighting
lightings.physics_notes: AO is an approximation of occluded skylight, not physically correct light transport (no bounce).
prompt_phrases: clay render with ambient occlusion only, uniform white material, soft contact shadows, neutral grey studio
untextured grey model, soft occlusion shading
lightings.eyewear_notes: Useful for a frame shape study: all-white clay frame on white with soft contact shadow shows the silhouette without reflections. Not suitable for lens realism.

lightings.name: Global illumination interior
lightings.name_th: แสงสะท้อนรอบทิศในห้อง
lightings.setup: CG concept: light from windows/lamps bounces between surfaces; walls and floors become secondary sources that tint and soften the room.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Daylight windows + warm practicals typical.
lightings.material_response: White walls pick up floor colour; wood warms the room; metals mirror the bright window.
lightings.depth_and_form: Natural depth through light gradient from window to back of room.
common_mistakes: over-bright bounce (flat)
missing colour bleed so it looks like AO only
lightings.physics_notes: Rendering equation: radiance at a point includes light arriving from all other surfaces; diffuse inter-reflection causes colour bleeding.
prompt_phrases: bright interior with realistic global illumination, sunlight from a large window bouncing softly off white walls and warm wooden floor
soft indirect light, natural colour bleeding, architectural visualisation
lightings.eyewear_notes: For a shop interior render, mirrored display glass and frames reflect the window: keep the camera off the window's reflection angle.

lightings.name: Product softbox
lightings.name_th: ไฟซอฟต์บ็อกซ์ถ่ายสินค้า
lightings.setup: Two large softboxes either side at ~45° (or one overhead scrim) close to the product; white/grey sweep; black cards for edge definition.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Daylight for accurate colour.
lightings.material_response: Even colour on acetate; metal shows long soft gradients; lenses show controlled strip reflections.
lightings.depth_and_form: Gentle; form from gradients and contact shadow.
common_mistakes: boxes reflected as two white squares in lenses
no edge definition on clear frames
lightings.physics_notes: Angle of incidence = angle of reflection: a highlight on glass, varnish or metal is a mirror image of the source; move the source or tilt the surface to move it. Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness.
prompt_phrases: studio product photo, two large softboxes at 45 degrees, clean white seamless background, soft contact shadow
evenly lit eyeglasses with controlled reflections
lightings.eyewear_notes: Recommended starting setup for sunglasses (curriculum-04). Feather the boxes so each lens shows one soft strip, not a full white panel; black cards beside clear frames.

lightings.name: Product gradient sweep
lightings.name_th: ไฟไล่เฉดบนสินค้า
lightings.setup: Large scrim/softbox angled close above/behind; product on acrylic or a curved sweep; the source's falloff creates a light-to-dark gradient on surfaces and backdrop; black cards both sides.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Neutral; gels on the backdrop for colour gradients.
lightings.material_response: Metal rims show a smooth highlight-to-dark gradient defining curvature; acrylic shows a mirror reflection.
lightings.depth_and_form: Gradients describe curvature and transparency (curriculum-04).
common_mistakes: gradient running the wrong way (bright at bottom)
mirror reflection doubled and messy
lightings.physics_notes: Inverse square: for a compact source, doubling the distance quarters the illuminance (-2 stops); a close source falls off fast across the scene (dark background), a far one lights everything evenly. Falloff across a large close source gives the gradient. Fresnel: reflectance of glass, skin oil and lacquer rises steeply toward grazing angles, so tilted lens surfaces and rims mirror bright surroundings strongly.
prompt_phrases: controlled gradient highlight along the top of the rim, black cards on both sides
large scrim angled above, smooth dark-to-light gradient background, subtle mirror reflection below
lightings.eyewear_notes: Curriculum-04 titanium setup: scrim above + black cards. Each clear lens should show one soft white strip reflection.

lightings.name: Backlit glass/transparent
lightings.name_th: ย้อนแสงวัสดุใส
lightings.setup: Light passes through a diffuser or white panel behind the transparent product (bright-field); black cards/flags at the sides make dark edges; or reverse: black background with two strip lights behind sides (dark-field) for bright edges.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Neutral to show material colour.
lightings.material_response: Transparent acetate shows colour and depth; glass lenses show thickness as dark (bright-field) or bright (dark-field) edges.
lightings.depth_and_form: Thickness and curvature read through refraction at edges.
common_mistakes: edges vanish without black cards
front light reflections spoiling the transparency
lightings.physics_notes: At the edges light strikes glass near grazing angles and is refracted/totally internally reflected away from the camera, producing the dark or bright outline.
prompt_phrases: clear acetate frames backlit through white diffusion, crisp dark edges defined by black cards
transparent glass on black with two bright strip lights tracing its edges
lightings.eyewear_notes: Best way to show crystal frames and lens thinness (curriculum-04 acetate example). Great for 'thin high-index lens' content: side-by-side edges.

lightings.name: Jewellery specular
lightings.name_th: ไฟประกายเครื่องประดับ
lightings.setup: Small hard sources or LED pins placed to hit facets/polished metal, plus a soft tent for base; black/white cards placed to put clean reflections on curved metal.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Neutral to keep gold/silver true.
lightings.material_response: Polished metal = mirror of the environment; facets sparkle; matte metal soft sheen.
lightings.depth_and_form: Highlights and dark reflections alternate to show curvature.
common_mistakes: mirror-polished metal reflecting the room/camera
too many sparkles = noise
lightings.physics_notes: Angle of incidence = angle of reflection: a highlight on glass, varnish or metal is a mirror image of the source; move the source or tilt the surface to move it. Polished metal has no diffuse colour: what you see is what it reflects.
prompt_phrases: macro of a polished gold hinge with crisp specular highlights and clean dark reflections
jewellery-style lighting, controlled sparkle on metal details
lightings.eyewear_notes: Use for detail punch-ins of metal temples, nose pads and engraved logos; keep the lens out of the sparkle zone.

lightings.name: Eyewear lens reflection control
lightings.name_th: คุมเงาสะท้อนเลนส์แว่น
lightings.setup: Sources placed outside the lens's mirror angle (high and wide); feathered large softboxes; black flags to absorb unwanted reflections; one intended soft strip reflection per lens; for portraits: key high, broad, chin slightly down.
lightings.key_direction: high and off-axis (above 30° or beyond 45° side)
lightings.intensity_ratio: per scene; lens reflection kept ~1-2 stops below skin highlight
lightings.color_temperature_note: Neutral, or match the scene.
lightings.material_response: Lens reads as glass through a faint gradient or strip; eyes clearly visible; AR coatings show a faint tinted (often green/violet) residual reflection.
lightings.depth_and_form: A controlled reflection shows lens curvature; zero reflection looks like an empty frame.
avoid_for: none — apply whenever lenses are visible; relax only for stylised silhouettes
common_mistakes: key at eye level in front (full glare)
removing every reflection (no lens)
AI empty lenses or random reflections
lightings.physics_notes: Angle of incidence = angle of reflection: a highlight on glass, varnish or metal is a mirror image of the source; move the source or tilt the surface to move it. Fresnel: reflectance of glass, skin oil and lacquer rises steeply toward grazing angles, so tilted lens surfaces and rims mirror bright surroundings strongly. Moving a source closer makes its reflection larger but dimmer per area, so glare softens (curriculum-04).
prompt_phrases: clear anti-reflective lenses, eyes fully visible through the lenses, no glare
each lens showing one soft white strip reflection, controlled reflections
lightings.eyewear_notes: Core rule of this shop: Glasses: keep the key above eye level and/or well off the lens axis so its mirror image bounces out of the lens toward floor or side; a slight chin-down or head turn away from the key moves it further; ask for 'clear anti-reflective lenses, eyes fully visible, no glare'. Do not remove every reflection: a faint edge highlight proves a lens is there (house 'lens layer' rule). Last resort: shoot with and without glasses and composite. AR coating is itself a selling point to show.

lightings.name: Flat cartoon cel
lightings.name_th: แสงการ์ตูนสีเรียบ
lightings.setup: One key direction per scene; shadows as flat colour shapes with hard terminator; optional pale rim line on the lit-opposite edge.
lightings.key_direction: chosen once per scene, consistent for all characters
lightings.color_temperature_note: Stylised: shadow is a chosen colour (often cooler/purple), not a temperature.
lightings.material_response: Materials suggested by shape of highlight (metal = sharp white shape, matte = none).
lightings.depth_and_form: Simple form; depth from overlap and colour value.
common_mistakes: soft gradient characters on cel background
shadows on different sides per character
lightings.physics_notes: Stylised quantisation of Lambert shading into two bands; direction must still be consistent.
prompt_phrases: 2D cel-shaded cartoon, flat colours, hard-edged shadows all falling to the right from a lamp at frame left
no gradients on characters, thin pale rim line
lightings.eyewear_notes: Draw lens as a pale tinted shape with one or two white diagonal glints; keep the eyes visible through it.

lightings.name: Two-tone anime shade
lightings.name_th: แสงอนิเมะสองโทน
lightings.setup: Base + one shadow tone (sometimes a second darker accent), hard edges, stylised hair highlights, often a strong rim and bloom on backlight.
lightings.key_direction: consistent per scene, often back-side for rim
lightings.color_temperature_note: Colour-scripted; warm/cool shadow tints chosen per scene.
lightings.shadow_quality: hard, graphic, sometimes with soft gradient overlay
lightings.material_response: Hair band highlight, eye highlights, glossy lens glint lines.
lightings.depth_and_form: Graphic form, depth via colour and atmosphere in painterly backgrounds.
common_mistakes: too many shadow tones
inconsistent light across panels
lightings.physics_notes: Stylised banding of shading; keep one light logic.
prompt_phrases: anime cel shading with a single shadow tone, crisp shadow edges, bright rim light
two-tone shading, glossy highlights
lightings.eyewear_notes: Classic anime 'glasses glint' (opaque white lens) hides the eyes — use only for comedy/mystery beats; otherwise keep eyes visible with a small diagonal glint.

lightings.name: Storybook soft glow
lightings.name_th: แสงนิทานนุ่มฟุ้ง
lightings.setup: Warm soft light with gentle bloom around light sources, low contrast, painterly gradients; shadows tinted warm/violet.
lightings.key_direction: soft side/top, from a motivated window or lantern
lightings.color_temperature_note: Warm dominant, cool accents.
lightings.material_response: Everything slightly matte and textured (paper/gouache).
lightings.depth_and_form: Soft form; atmosphere creates depth.
common_mistakes: bloom everywhere = haze
no darks so image looks washed
lightings.physics_notes: Bloom mimics light scattering in the eye/lens around bright sources (veiling glare).
prompt_phrases: soft warm storybook glow, gentle bloom around the lantern, painterly gradients
cozy low-contrast warm light
lightings.eyewear_notes: Paint a soft warm glint on the lens, no hard reflection.

lightings.name: Noir venetian blinds
lightings.name_th: แสงนัวร์ผ่านมู่ลี่
lightings.setup: Hard source outside a window shining through venetian blinds, projecting parallel bar shadows across subject and wall; low ambient; smoke optional.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Often rendered black-and-white.
lightings.material_response: Bars wrap over form, revealing contour; metal and lenses catch stripes.
lightings.depth_and_form: Stripes bend over shapes: strong 3D cue.
common_mistakes: soft source → blurry stripes
stripes across the eyes when the face matters
lightings.physics_notes: Penumbra width scales with the source's apparent angular size seen from the subject: larger or closer = softer edges and smoother gradients. Raising power only changes brightness, not hardness. Distance between blind and subject also blurs stripes (penumbra grows with distance).
prompt_phrases: film noir, hard light through venetian blinds casting striped shadows across his face
black and white, smoky office, slatted shadows
lightings.eyewear_notes: A stripe falling exactly across the lenses hides the eyes; let it cross the forehead or cheek instead, a bright bar on the frame reads as stylish.

lightings.name: Sunset rim, warm/cool
lightings.name_th: ขอบแสงอุ่นตัดเย็น
lightings.setup: Warm low sun or warm light as rim from behind; cool sky or cool-gelled fill on the front; complementary temperature contrast.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Warm rim ~2500-3500 K vs cool fill ~6500-7500 K.
lightings.material_response: Hair and frame edges glow orange; skin front cool.
lightings.depth_and_form: Temperature contrast separates planes.
common_mistakes: front too blue (cold skin)
rim flare across the face
lightings.physics_notes: Rayleigh scattering removes blue from the long low-sun path (warm direct light) while the sky that remains acts as a blue fill. Warm/cool contrast is a perceptual/colour-appearance effect strengthened by simultaneous contrast.
prompt_phrases: warm orange sunset rim light on hair and shoulders, cool blue fill on the face
teal and orange temperature contrast
lightings.eyewear_notes: Warm rim lights the frame outline; cool front fill should stay soft and high so the lens stays clear.

lightings.name: Screen glow on face
lightings.name_th: แสงจอบนใบหน้า
lightings.setup: Phone/monitor is the only key: close, below or in front of the face; cool, flickering; dark room.
lightings.source_size: small (phone) to medium (monitor) but very close = fairly soft
lightings.color_temperature_note: Screens typically D65-ish; reads cool against warm room light.
lightings.material_response: Skin cool, eyes reflect the screen rectangle; lenses mirror the screen.
lightings.depth_and_form: Only the front of the face lit; strong falloff.
common_mistakes: screen light hitting the wall behind (wrong falloff)
warm screen colour
lightings.physics_notes: Inverse square: for a compact source, doubling the distance quarters the illuminance (-2 stops); a close source falls off fast across the scene (dark background), a far one lights everything evenly. A screen 30 cm away falls off steeply across the face.
prompt_phrases: face lit only by the cool blue glow of a phone screen in a dark room
late-night laptop glow on her face
lightings.eyewear_notes: The screen reflection in the lenses is the story here (blue-light / eye strain content). Keep it to a small rectangle at the lens bottom so eyes stay visible.

lightings.name: Lightning flash
lightings.name_th: แสงฟ้าแลบ
lightings.setup: Very brief, very bright cool flash from a window or the sky; hard shadows; between flashes the scene is dark; in video 2-3 flicker frames.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Approximate; reads as blue-white.
lightings.material_response: All glossy surfaces flash; rain streaks lit.
lightings.depth_and_form: Momentary reveal of shape.
common_mistakes: flash lasting too long
no dark frames between flashes
lightings.physics_notes: Real strokes last microseconds to milliseconds, so a 1-3 frame flash with decay reads correctly.
prompt_phrases: sudden lightning flash through the window, blue-white light and hard shadows
storm night, lightning illuminating the room
lightings.eyewear_notes: Lenses become bright mirrors for one frame — a good horror beat (eyes hidden). In product use, avoid.

lightings.name: Snow bounce
lightings.name_th: แสงสะท้อนจากหิมะ
lightings.setup: Snow acts as a huge white reflector filling from below; overcast sky above or sun; very bright overall.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Cool in shade; very blue shadows.
lightings.material_response: Skin lit from under the chin; lenses mirror white ground; sunglasses justified.
lightings.depth_and_form: Low form; under-light from the ground.
common_mistakes: underexposed grey snow
losing white detail
lightings.physics_notes: Fresh snow reflects a large fraction of visible light (high albedo), so the ground becomes the fill; UV is reflected too.
prompt_phrases: bright snowy landscape, soft light bouncing up from the snow, cool blue shadows
crisp winter light
lightings.eyewear_notes: Strong lower reflections in lenses (white ground); sunglasses/UV message fits. Ask for 'eyes visible through lightly tinted lenses' if needed.

lightings.name: Stage colour gels
lightings.name_th: ไฟเวทีเจลสี
lightings.setup: Two or more coloured gelled lights (e.g. magenta key from one side, cyan from the other) on a dark background; colours mix where they overlap.
lightings.color_temperature_note: Saturated gel colours; not on the Kelvin scale. CTO/CTB are the temperature gels (curriculum-04).
lightings.shadow_quality: coloured shadows (each shadow lit by the other colour)
lightings.material_response: Skin takes both hues; white frames turn colourful; metal shows two-coloured edges.
lightings.depth_and_form: Colour separates planes and sides.
common_mistakes: skin turning green
three+ colours = mud
lightings.physics_notes: Additive light mixing: overlapping red/blue gives magenta etc.; coloured shadows appear where one source is blocked.
prompt_phrases: magenta light from the left and cyan light from the right on a dark background
colourful stage gels, coloured shadows, energetic
lightings.eyewear_notes: Coloured edge lines on the frame look great for beat-clip hooks; show the true colour in a separate neutral punch-in.
